text:
jana: Sales just escalated: Customer Z insists tenant routing + SCIM-based provisioning must be in v1 or they won't sign. They want a firm June 20 date.
owen: SCIM in v1? that's a big ask. Our public v1 target is July.
harper: What's their non-negotiable: SCIM only, or can we offer a temporary provisioning path?
jana: They explicitly called SCIM "must-have" because they want automated provisioning tied to HR systems, but said they'd consider a one-off import if it's time-limited.
meera: One-off CSV import as stopgap is low-effort but not ideal for their IT security audit. Another idea: an "SCIM bridge" where we host a small connector that polls their HR export endpoint and maps users for 6 weeks. Less work than full SCIM endpoint.
luis: Bridge sounds clever. Engineering estimate: full SCIM endpoint + mapping/tests = 4-5w. Managed bridge + validation = ~2w and fewer test permutations.
owen: Risks: the bridge is operational burden and more manual runbook. But it can buy us time to ship full SCIM in v1 rather than v1.1.
meera: Acceptance criteria for bridge-canary: automated user provisioning for 3 pilot orgs, daily reconciliation, audit trail exported to their SIEM, documented deprecation path when full SCIM is rolled out.
jana: Sales wants a firm GA date for full SCIM if we do bridge. Can we promise Jul 20 for full SCIM and June 20 for the bridge?
ohio (sales-bot): Customer Z agreed to evaluate a bridge if we provide weekly checkpoints and a firm SCIM GA date. They asked for SLA language around user provisioning uptime.
infra-bot: Created ISSUE-BC-777 "scim-bridge-pilot" and linked to roadmap.
luis: Operational mitigations: run the bridge in a private VPC, limit access via short-lived credentials, set a circuit-breaker if reconciliation errors >1%. We'll provide runbook and on-call rota.
owen: Still need legal for SLA caveat: bridge is temporary and we can't promise full enterprise SLAs on a stopgap. Sam from legal needs to draft language.
meera: Dev assignments if greenlit: 2 engs to bridge (2w), 1 eng to SCIM core (parallel start) but focus SCIM QA in week 3-6. That generally hits Jul 20 for full SCIM if no big blockers.
jana: Decision proposal capture here: Offer a managed SCIM-bridge pilot for Jun 20 (feature-flagged, 3 pilots) + commit to full SCIM GA by Jul 20 as part of v1. Move promo analytics & cohort export to v1.1 to free capacity.
luis: I'll write the canary runbook and infra plan. meera -> PRD for bridge today; owen -> SCIM roadmap & QA plan by Thurs; jana -> confirm acceptance with customer and schedule weekly checkpoints.
jana: :thumbsup: I'll update the sales thread and roadmap after the PRD. Closing note: bridge is pragmatic compromise, but call out deprecation and SLA limitations in writing.
